question.addMediaHint: Add an image, video or audio to your question

config.noTimeLimitHint: Points are awarded based on answer order. There is no time limit to answer.
config.categoryHint: Consecutive questions with the same category form a round. The leaderboard is only shown when the category changes.
config.maxPointsHint: Maximum points awarded for a correct answer
config.penaltyHint: Points deducted for a wrong answer (total cannot go below 0)
config.scoringModeHint.strict: Full points only if all correct answers are selected and no wrong ones
config.scoringModeHint.balanced: Partial points: correct selections minus wrong ones
config.scoringModeHint.lenient: Points per correct answer, no penalty for wrong ones

estimation.title: Estimation

inputModeHint.slider: Players pick a value with a slider between the bounds
inputModeHint.input: Players type a number between the bounds

estimation.stepHint: Precision of the slider and the expected answer
estimation.marginHint: Answers within this distance of the correct answer score from 100% (exact) down to 50%. Answers outside score nothing.

puzzle.title: Puzzle
puzzle.hint: 12 words form 3 groups of 4. Players type the connection of each group. Every group found earns an equal share of the points, whoever is first.
puzzle.connectionPlaceholder: What the 4 words have in common
puzzle.spellingHint: Capitals, accents and extra spaces are ignored. Typos are not, so add spelling variants as accepted answers.

pin.title: Pin on the map
pin.hint: Players tap a spot on the image. The closer to the right spot, the more points, whatever the speed.
pin.radiusHint: Pins this close to the right spot earn full points, in percent of the image width.
pin.maxDistanceHint: From this distance on a pin earns nothing. In between the points fall in a straight line.
pin.imageWidthHint: Optional. Fill in how wide the image is in real life to show distances in that unit instead of a percentage.
pin.needsImage: Add an image or map above, then tap the right spot on it.
pin.placeHint: Tap the image to place the right spot
pin.legend: Green: right spot and full points radius. Dashed red: distance where points reach zero.
pin.placeHintMap: Zoom and move the map, then tap the right spot. The map you leave behind is where players start.
pin.legendMap: Green: right spot and full points radius. Dashed red: distance where points reach zero. Distances are in km.
pin.radiusHintMap: Pins this close to the right spot earn full points, in km.

media.dropHint: Drop your images, audio and video files here, or use the Upload button
